source_role: Conclusion connective, fronted differently in English.
The cited statement; the author name in English is contextual identification.
Meaning is the lexical core of don in lung de'i don. The wider real meaning HGM variant is positive evidence but does not force the discourse emphasis real into this tighter token.
Recipient of the pus appearance.
Appearance predicate, distinct from the two external-existence predicates.
First external-object compound, in the explanatory that is clause.
Unique tighter modifier within the first external-object compound.
Unique tighter object head within that same compound.
As an outer object; skip the earlier correlative as it appeared.
Existence as an external object, explicitly repeated by the English that is paraphrase. The earlier existed and to exist are not separately banked.
The drop of pus in the first hypothetical clause.
The amount is one drop, not the later whole river.
Indefinite minimizer under med: 'ga' is single in not a single drop, explicitly attested in HGM; yang adds emphasis and is omitted rather than assigned a false missing exponent.
Single privative existential word requires the negative existential phrase; no separate Tibetan negator is invented.
Conditional construction recast as the introductory Suppose.
Second external-object compound modifies the river pus.
Tighter modifier within the second compound.
Tighter head within the second compound.
Third English as belongs to the second external-existence clause.
Third English existed is the second source external-existence predicate.
Second pus fills the river.
Filling predicate; whole is an unbanked intensifier on river.
The river itself.

The whole lta ga la yod construction asks a rhetorical existence question: lta supplies the topic/inference behind then, ga la the rhetorical impossibility, yod existence. could there belongs to that complete English recast.
Concessive connector in the final sentence.
The beings who see pus due to their karma.
Explicit plural demonstrative licenses These, placed before beings in English.
Karma is the force conditioning the perception.
English verbal recast of the force/power noun, corroborated by C05:295; supplied they are and to do so stay outside.

Final gis marks las kyi dbang as the causal instrument of seeing; English recasts dbang as forced and expresses the karma cause with by. The earlier rnag gis belongs to full of pus and is not this occurrence.
Third pus is the object actually seen by the beings.
Lexical list-continuation sogs (etcetera) owns and so on as a whole closing gesture, without taking the pus noun. d5 is a word classification; the exact supplied-head allowance is named separately.
Actual seeing, distinguished from appeared earlier.
